comments.value: This would be a nice addition.

"
>Friends in world: 
>Blocked users in world:
"
Would be a great addition!

Actually I want to see list of friends per instance, when I join F / F+ instances I'm joining a group of people, not just a specific friend...

It's always somewhat awkward when you join a friend, but that friend is talking with bunch of people I don't know at all. I want to be intentional about joining such instance, not accidental.

This is especially severe when you're bi/tri-lingual and friends only speak 1 language.
Exactly this, it would save me so much unnecessary awkward conversations.

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value:
I agree with this opinion. Since it is “Tracked”, I very much hope it will be implemented in the not-too-distant future.

Various opinions on relationships have been posted, but I believe that measures to address the entry point of the problem are the least costly and most effective, and I would like to see them implemented.

Please allow me to make a specific proposal to help lower the cost of consideration.

The following images are social as of 2025/04/08.

I would guess that the area I have circled in yellow marker is the current composition of the block elements. (The area I have highlighted in blue is my guess for the inline elements.)

What I would suggest is to add a block element at the bottom with the same shape as the top block element. And the inline elements should be canned. (e.g., This instance contains a blocked or blocked user.)

Since the code to determine the presence of a “friend” user in an instance already exists in the social implementation, there is no need to create new code to determine the presence of a “blocked” user in an instance. Also, there is no need to retrieve and display user data. Just display a canned message.

Imaginary code

```

current_world = get_current_world(friend)

users_in_world = get_users_in_world(current_world)

has_blocked_user = users_in_world.any? { |user| user[:blocked] }

if has_blocked_user

  # Add block elements to display

end

```

The following opinions seek the same effect as this opinion, but it would be much easier and more effective to implement this opinion than to implement them.

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/more-robust-block-system-notify-users-if-blocked-user-enters-world

details: It would be nice to be able to see if you have a friend or a blocked person in it, because then you could drop a portal to your friends world (if it is friends+ or public) or avoid the world were a blocked person is.
title: Being able to see if a world has a friend or a block person in it befor you join.
